description: This Java source file defines the MyJobService class, which extends JobService to handle scheduled jobs via Android's JobScheduler. It manages job execution, communicates with an activity through Messenger, and handles job lifecycle events.

classes.name: MyJobService
classes.description: A JobService subclass that handles scheduled jobs, communicates with the activity via Messenger, and manages job lifecycle events.

methods.description: Initializes the service and logs creation.

methods.name: onStartCommand
methods.description: Receives the intent, extracts Messenger for callbacks, and sets up communication.

methods.name: onStartJob
methods.description: Handles the start of a job, schedules completion after a specified duration, and updates activity via Messenger.

methods.name: onStopJob
methods.description: Handles job interruption, sends stop message, and indicates job should not be retried.

methods.description: Sends a message to the activity via Messenger, with error handling.
